name: Reframe vertical
description: Re-frames the selected video clips on their main subject (people with YOLOX, faces with YuNet when installed): a 16:9 shot fills a 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5 frame, the crop follows the subject with a smooth pan, as Motion Position keyframes (sequence.autoReframe). One undo step. The detection models are optional downloads (the last two entries ask before fetching them).
author: FilmCraft

entries.label: Recadrer en 9:16
entries.description: Vertical short: 1080 x 1920 with the subject followed.

entries.label: Recadrer en 9:16 (sous-titres)
entries.description: Like 9:16, zoomed in a little and keeping the lower fifth free for subtitles.

entries.label: Installer le détecteur de personnes (YOLOX-Nano)
entries.description: Shows the size, source and licence, then downloads the model once you accept.

entries.label: Installer le détecteur de visages (YuNet, facultatif)
entries.description: Lets the framing centre on faces instead of the upper body.
